subject.title: fix(plugins): surface oversized-file warnings in doctor migration reads

question: Should `openclaw doctor --fix` preserve a supported recovery or migration path for legacy Active Memory, Device Pair, and Reef files above 10 MiB, or intentionally require manual intervention for those users?
rationale: This is an upgrade and persistent-state contract choice: the patch improves local-file safety, but it also determines whether doctor can complete migration of existing user data that exceeds the new limit.

options.title: Preserve recoverable migration
options.body: Keep descriptor-bound limits but add one bounded, data-preserving Doctor migration or explicit in-product recovery flow for oversized files across all three plugins.

options.title: Accept manual recovery
options.body: Keep the skip-and-warn behavior only with explicit owner approval and a documented, supported recovery procedure for each affected legacy state type.

recommendation.title: Preserve recoverable migration
recommendation.body: Keep descriptor-bound limits but add one bounded, data-preserving Doctor migration or explicit in-product recovery flow for oversized files across all three plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The current head commit owns the exact migration semantics that need an explicit upgrade-contract decision.
